content.comment_body: Hello, thank you for your detailed explanation and example. I am attempting to connect my Cognex device to [product_name], but I'm encountering issues with the Modbus output communication. On the Cognex side, I want to send the status of each job step, but in [product_name] I am only receiving the overall JOB PASS result—not the outcome of individual inspections, even when I try enabling each tool. Has anyone else faced a similar issue? Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing integration challenges between Cognex and [product_name] when trying to monitor Modbus outputs for each individual inspection step. [product_name] only receives the final job result instead of the detailed results for every inspection step, which points to potential communication or data mapping constraints between the devices using Modbus outputs.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to receive and show each individual inspection result from Cognex through Modbus—not just the overall job outcome.
